BCCI Postpones IPL Stakeholder Meeting Due to PM Modi's Event

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has postponed a crucial meeting with Indian Premier League (IPL) stakeholders that was scheduled for October 15. The meeting was rescheduled due to Prime Minister Narendra Modi's felicitation of Indian sports teams. Hindustan reported the postponement of the BCCI meeting concerning IPL 2027.
